description:
ABOUT LITTLE G CHARTER
Little G is a multi-purpose custom 70 foot length overall by 21.5 foot breadth Elliott Sport Yacht.  Built in Venice, California, she is considered to be one of the finest quality sport yachts ever built in California.  The hull was designed by Ed Monk Jr. and boasts one of the most forgiving rides of a boat her size especially as equipped with Gyro Fin Stabilizers.  With a close to a 400 sf cockpit, Little G has the size to handle big game and crew to help get it done.  The cockpit is equipped with a custom 800 gallon bait tank able to hold over 40 scoops of bait to take offshore.  On the finer side, the bait tank also moonlights as a huge teak wrapped bar ready to be sat for six thirsty guests (Coined the “Little G Bar”).  Additionally, the cockpit is station for two 1.5 ton fish holds insuring your catch comes home sushi quality.  The Tender decks house a 2,500 lbs Davit that makes quick work of launching the 14 foot Custom Greenough Center Console and 11 foot Caribe Tender.  Above it all is the spacious flybridge with seating and a view for all.   The forward decks are massive and accessed by huge walkaround decks on both sides of the vessel.  An additional bow bait tank is located center-line on the bow with additional seating for a sunny cruise. As you come inside from the cockpit, the spacious saloon is appointed with all leather seating, Chef’s galley, custom teak dining table and bar await you.  Little G is equipped with a first-class entertainment system including 43” Smart TV with Gyro Direct-TV and the sound system.  As you go down to the steps to the companionway, three staterooms below include the Master’s stateroom with Queen and head to Port, forward to Starboard is the second stateroom with bunks, single over double and forward stateroom has bunks for four.  The two forward staterooms share a second head.

 From the saloon up forward, the ships wheelhouse equipped with the latest generation navigational, fish finding and safety equipment standing ready for any voyage near or far.  Additionally, there is ample seating and additional bunks for crew.

 Little G is also equipped with the finest safety systems and late generation mains engines and generators.   These systems are maintained to the extreme and stand ready to leave for Alaska or Costa Rica at any moment.
